    Corrections in each weight component (Proposition 10.1, last paragraph) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "All these constructions can be chosen to preserve the simultaneous integer weights: lifting a basis of H_ℤ to mesh weights by Lemma 7.4 gives the modules M_i⁽²⁾ compatible weight gradings, and the corrections can be chosen in each weight component."

    A second ℤ-grading (a weight) on Λ, M, N, compatible with the same actions and commuting with the internal degree, refines graded Ext: the corrections used in Proposition 10.1 come from Ext¹ and Ext² (ExtVanish _ _ 0 _, ExtVanish _ _ 1 _), and a correction H with dH = F can be replaced by its weight-w component PW w H when F has weight w (dPW0, dPW1). The component is computed on homogeneous inputs, where it is the weight projection of the value; two multilinear cochains agreeing on homogeneous inputs agree (ext_one, ext_two). Several weights are treated one after another (extVanish_weights): each projection preserves the degree and the earlier weights.

    (g.proj w) (∑ i ∈ s, x i) = ∑ i ∈ s with f i = w, x i
